event: 119th birth anniversary of Dr Babu Jagjivan Ram
identityConfidence: OCCASION: HIGH — Babu Jagjivan Ram was born on 5 April 1908, and his Jayanti is observed on 5 April each year. He was a freedom fighter, long-serving union minister and Deputy Prime Minister, and a leading advocate for the scheduled castes. In Karnataka the anniversary is observed by district administrations together with Zilla Panchayats, the Department of Social Welfare and the Dr B R Ambedkar Development Corporation. YEAR: MEDIUM — see the counting note below. VENUE: UNRESOLVED.
